title: Linda's Surprise
subtitle: Reading Practice
tagline: Read along, listen, and practise out loud.

s: This little girl is Linda.
She is five years old.
She likes to play with pets.
One day she asked her mother if she could have a pet.
Her mother said, Ask your Daddy when he comes home from work.
So Linda asked her father about a pet.
He said, "Well, maybe".
Then one day Mother and Father took Linda to see Mr. and Mrs. Brown.
They had a pretty gray cat.
Linda loved the cat.
The cat was so soft and warm.
Linda played with the cat.
She sang about the cat all the way home.
Linda loved the cat so much that she ask to see it.
Mrs. Brown called the cat.
But the cat was busy.
"The cat has a surprise for you," said Mrs. Brown.
"Come and see it."
When they found her, Linda was suprised.
There in the box were five little kittens.
Two white and three were gray like the mother cat.
Linda wanted a kitten.
Her mother said to ask Daddy.
Daddy said the cat would not let them take away a kitten.
The kittens are too little, he said.
So Linda went home.
She thought and thought about the kittens.
How pretty they were.
Linda wanted a kitten.
Linda had a birthday.
She was six years old.
Her mother said they would go and eat lunch with Mrs. Brown.
Linda was happy.
She would see the kittens again.
Mrs. Brown said, "Happy birthday, Linda.
You are a big girl now."
After lunch Linda played with the kittens.
Mrs. Brown said, "Linda, you may have a kitten of your very own.
Which one would you like?"
Oh, Linda was so happy.
She looked and looked.
Then she found a kitten.
It looked like the mother cat.
Linda loved the kitten.
They took the kitten home in a big brown basket.
The kitten did not like the basket.
She wanted out.
She cried and cried.
Finally she pushed and pushed on the top of the basket.
The basket opened up.
The kitten jumped out and she sat in Linda's lap.
Linda and the kitten sang all the way home.

words.en: an animal you keep at home
the colour between black and white
something happy you did not expect
a bag made of straw for carrying
the day you were born, once a year
the top of your legs when you sit

quiz.q: How old is Linda at the start of the story?
What did Mrs. Brown's cat have?
Why could Linda not take a kitten home the first time?
Where did the kitten sit on the way home?
